description: Undo and redo in an SvGrid Base, in Svelte 5. Ctrl+Z undoes cell edits, records added or deleted and fields added, changed or deleted, in the order they were made, and Ctrl+Shift+Z or Ctrl+Y redoes them. A deleted record comes back in its place with its links, and the tab bar's arrows say what the next undo will do.

faq.question: What can be undone?
faq.answer: Cell edits, pastes and fills, records added or deleted, records imported from a file, and fields added, changed or deleted. View settings such as a filter or a sort are not part of the history; a view keeps them as you leave them.

faq.question: Does undoing a delete bring back the links?
faq.answer: Yes. Deleting a task removes it from its project's list of tasks; undo puts the task back where it was and the project lists it again, because the step restores the records of every table the delete touched.

faq.question: What happens to the history when I switch tables?
faq.answer: Each table keeps its own history while another table is shown. Go back to the table and Ctrl+Z carries on from where you left it.

faq.question: Which license does it need?
faq.answer: SvGrid Base is part of the Suite edition of @svgrid/enterprise. Without a key it runs with a watermark, so it can be evaluated as is.
